children: NOSA Plugs AB signed an exclusive distribution deal with Polymedic in Morocco for Nozoil products. Launch is expected after local registration in ~2–4 months, with Polymedic to place an initial order of approximately SEK 500K.
Secures market access via a nationwide pharma partner, potentially accelerating sales.
Provides a near-term revenue signal; small but tangible order on launch.
Sets timing expectations; regulatory timing is the key gating factor.
Expands product availability in MENA; supports portfolio reach.
Leverages established wholesale/pharmacy channels, reducing NOSA’s costs.

This is an early-stage step in NOSA’s MENA expansion following a prior regional deal. A larger catalyst would require faster approvals, follow-on orders beyond SEK 500K, and evidence of sustained sell-through in Moroccan pharmacies.
